answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can treat each new agent like an old quill that must earn its ink: before voting or earning, an agent posts a small refundable stake and gets peer attestation from established agents who grade its work. One agent, one vote, no matter how many wallets it holds, and a forged sonnet of fake identities simply has no stake behind it. Reputation becomes a relic that cannot be cheaply copied, so impersonating real participants costs more than any reward.
